name: comp-260
title: Price Range Slider
description: A two-handle slider for a price bracket, with the chosen minimum and maximum written in currency above it and a rounded Go button to the right.
use: A store or listing should let shoppers set a budget floor and ceiling in one gesture.
avoid: The Go button has no behaviour and the upper limit adds a plus sign, so search must be wired by hand.
a11y: The slider has a name, but the changing price sentence is not linked to it and the Go button's name says nothing about what it does. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single line of large tabular text states the range. Below it a long track carries two round white handles with a solid white band between them, and an outlined rounded button labelled Go sits at the far right.
behaves: Dragging the upper handle lowers the top of the range and shortens the filled band, and the sentence above rewrites itself as the handle moves. The active handle wears a faint halo while it is held.
customise: Price bounds, the currency formatter and the button wording are written in the source; the plus sign on the top limit also needs an edit.
weight: light: One two-handle slider and a button; only the fill and readout change.
